safe_activation_protocol.join_order: ascending register_ns with flow_id as the tie breaker
safe_activation_protocol.fast_join_rule: for each admitted small-set join, fully ACK every required incumbent prepare grant before sending the required newcomer activation grant
safe_activation_protocol.high_transition_rule: the fifth registration irreversibly enters high-fan-in collection; transition prepare begins only after both collection flush and serialized prefix closure
safe_activation_protocol.transition_union_rule: transition prepare incumbent flow IDs and transition activation waiter flow IDs are disjoint and their union is every registered lifecycle flow
safe_activation_protocol.release_rule: after safe activation closure, every admitted release generation is ACK-optional, contains no join, and never decreases a continuing target; low-mode release is optional and immediate, while post-transition high-mode release obeys the geometric active-count rule
safe_activation_protocol.retry_semantics: wire frame accounting includes every retry and duplicate ACK; the frozen normal path admits neither
safe_activation_protocol.terminal_condition: phase, pending ACKs, pending membership, waiter snapshots, collection state, and revision delta are all zero

initial_collection_protocol.scope: the first high-fan-in waiter snapshot after the fifth registration
initial_collection_protocol.timer_rule: schedule at min(last_waiter_registration_ns + quiet_ns, transition_registration_ns + derived_hard_ns)
initial_collection_protocol.barrier_rule: transition_prepare_start_ns is not earlier than collection_flush_ns or prefix_close_ns
initial_collection_protocol.hard_tie_rule: a quiet target equal to the hard deadline is classified as a hard flush
initial_collection_protocol.post_initial_rule: retain the 12480-ns post-initial window and geometric completion-release behavior

selection_policy: K=4, the two safe phases, the V10 replay inputs, fresh pilot and formal identities, frame ceilings, the first-use 60-byte low-queue measurement correction, and the N=15 preservation gates are frozen before replay. Replay and pilot are mechanism-only. Formal performance remains sealed until all 40 mechanism cells pass. A failure rejects V11 and cannot select another K, phase rule, seed, N, arm, queue gate, or subset.

candidate_admission.low_n_frame_bound_derivation: serialized safe admission is at most N(N+1) frames and immediate per-completion optional release is at most N(N-1)/2 grant frames, for total F <= (3N^2+N)/2

scalability_holdout.required_control_frame_envelope: F<=7,26,43,64 at N=2,4,8,15 respectively; the low-N values safely include immediate per-completion optional release, and the high-N values are frozen event-pattern ceilings rather than a universal asymptotic claim

scope_limits: V11 is a first preregistered test of serialized prepare/activate safety, not an admitted default algorithm.
The 60-byte small-queue absolute CI gate is first used by V11 and does not retroactively change V10's rejection.
The fifth registration selects high-fan-in mode irreversibly within the epoch; no parameter or performance-based threshold selection is allowed.
The frame ceilings include retries and are only for the frozen one-epoch completion-only identities through N=15; V11 makes no universal sub-3N claim.
Remaining-aware refresh, proactive release, receiver concurrency, size priority, and tail bypass remain outside this isolation experiment.
Performance metrics remain sealed until replay, pilot, and every formal mechanism cell pass.
